phase: 7 -- the official destination-marketing rosters, measured before being trusted
the_bureau_was_measured: Visit Phoenix, Experience Scottsdale, Visit Chandler and Experience Glendale are Simpleview installs; their own public listings endpoint states each partner's full premises, and is read with an EMPTY filter (every partner) so no category filter of the bureau's is trusted. Visit Mesa is a Craft CMS install on the Aurora / Carlsbad / Jacksonville partner platform. Tempe Tourism and Discover Gilbert are WordPress installs that publish their own hotel sitemap.
the_category_filter_is_read_not_trusted: Simpleview partners are pulled UNFILTERED and each partner's OWN categories are read; every Mesa listing page is fetched and its OWN data-dms-category-name is read, because a directory's category filter may be INERT.
a_roster_row_is_not_a_policy: Tier-3 IDENTITY and ROUTING evidence. The bureau's category PROPOSES that a partner is lodging; the property's own page decides what it is. No roster row carries a pet policy.
the_bureau_does_not_decide_membership: Admission is the property's OWN postal code against the corridor registry and nothing else.

bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.visitarizona.com: 403 to this client (the state tourism office)
bureaus_measured_and_not_walked.visitgoodyear.com: 200; a WordPress sitemap of pages only -- no partner directory
